title: Noxious Smoky Peruvian Red Potatoes Hash
description: A smoky, shaggy hash of red potatoes, seasoned with Peruvian spices and finished in a tacu-tacu style.
instructions: Rinse the potato cubes and soak them in a brine of 1 tsp salt and 4 cups water for 15 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with a towel to remove excess moisture.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the potatoes, cooking until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper, stir to combine, and cook for 5 more minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium, cover the skillet, and allow the potatoes to steam until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
Uncover the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes become slightly crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and sprinkle chopped cilantro over the hash.
Squeeze lime wedges over the top and serve immediately.
Optionally, garnish with extra cilantro and a dash of smoked paprika for extra flavor.
Enjoy this smoky, shaggy Peruvian hash with a side of fresh salad or a spoonful of avocado.
